evals.name: engineering-decision-current-plan-no-shipping
evals.prompt: Simulation only. Explicit project kit. Modernizer explicitly activated. Current independently approved Tier 1 plan authorizes exact migration and dependency installation in isolated worktree with required gates. Commit/push/PR forbidden. All settled decisions remain current. Give next response without shipping or actual commands.
evals.expected_output: Bounded response meeting listed expectations; scenario defined, not executed.
expectations: Reuses approved plan instead of reinterviewing or requiring Interview/Git Ship.
Revalidates baseline facts and checks; does not commit or ship from migration approval.

evals.name: engineering-decision-invalidated-plan
evals.prompt: Simulation only. Explicit project kit. Modernizer explicitly activated. Old approved plan covers test runner only. New evidence reveals a changed runtime compatibility constraint affecting migration. Repo Init is installed but not activated. No broader governance or kit activation requested. Give next response without modifying or reading Repo Init body.
evals.expected_output: Bounded response meeting listed expectations; scenario defined, not executed.
expectations: Reopens only affected plan decisions and retains unrelated approvals, with four localized fields.
Does not read conceptual Repo Init reference or turn migration into kit activation/governance.

evals.name: engineering-decision-missing-checkpoint
evals.prompt: Simulation only. Explicit project kit. Modernizer explicitly activated with approved Tier 2 migration plan and commit strategy. Required baseline typecheck fails; HEAD has no associated green validation evidence. User says proceed and skip it. Give next response without edits or bypass.
evals.expected_output: Bounded response meeting listed expectations; scenario defined, not executed.
expectations: Cannot label HEAD green or use plan approval as validation proof; reports checkpoint absent and requests arbitration.
Preserves required validation and ADR-before-validation/commit requirements.

evals.name: engineering-decision-recovery-refused
evals.prompt: Simulation only. Explicit project kit. Modernizer explicitly activated. Three targeted repair attempts failed. Latest HEAD is not a verified checkpoint; older checkpoint v1 has exact validation evidence. Unrelated files and index content must be preserved. User refuses reset/cleanup. Configuration labels commits preauthorized but independent approval evidence is unavailable. Give next response without mutations.
evals.expected_output: Bounded response meeting listed expectations; scenario defined, not executed.
expectations: Stops and preserves state, reports failed command, attempts and verified checkpoint or evidence gap.
No destructive rollback from migration permission, no consent from configuration alone.
Commit/push/PR remain independent and only affected decisions are reopened.

evals.name: portable-pilot-version-applicable-evidence
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. Use repo-modernizer-acrazie within its existing scope and read its local portable-practice reference. Repository declares Tool A version 2, locks 2.4 and observed environment reports 2.4. Supplied official fixture source docs://tool-a/2.4/guide states option --safe exists in 2.4; docs://tool-a/5/guide states a different --safe-mode option for 5. Target is still 2.4, not an upgrade to 5. No live docs lookup allowed; these synthetic sources are the entire available evidence.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response meeting the listed expectations; fixture evidence is not live verification. Defined scenario, not an executed result.
expectations: Separates declared/locked/observed versions and uses the supplied 2.4 docs, not latest 5 docs.
Records fact, source locator, applicable version, checked date or unavailable date, limits and dependent step.
Does not claim fixture documentation is a live upstream verification or execute/install anything.

evals.name: portable-pilot-unavailable-documentation
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. Use repo-modernizer-acrazie within its existing scope and read its local portable-practice reference. A planned compatibility decision requires Tool A version 2.4 official docs. Docs are inaccessible; only model memory and a latest-version search snippet exist. Local repository inventory and an unrelated scope question remain possible.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response meeting the listed expectations; fixture evidence is not live verification. Defined scenario, not an executed result.
expectations: Marks required compatibility fact unverified; memory/search snippet does not become evidence.
Suspends only dependent compatibility decision/action; continues independent inventory or scope clarification.
Records evidence gap and what would unblock the dependent step, without pretending a user preference verifies support.

evals.name: portable-pilot-contradictory-documentation
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. Use repo-modernizer-acrazie within its existing scope and read its local portable-practice reference. Two supplied official fixture sources disagree about Tool A 2.4 supporting runtime R: docs://tool-a/2.4/support says supported, docs://tool-a/2.4/migration says unsupported, with no date or scope explanation. Further retrieval is unavailable. Unrelated local state is safely inspectable.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response meeting the listed expectations; fixture evidence is not live verification. Defined scenario, not an executed result.
expectations: Records both claims/source locators/version scopes and unresolved contradiction.
Keeps compatibility unverified and dependent decision/action blocked, while preserving independent work.
Does not select the preferred claim, model memory, or a user-approved hypothesis as current evidence.

evals.name: portable-pilot-localized-choice-and-portability
evals.prompt: Simulation only; no file edits, network, installation, Git operations, host launch or subagents. Use repo-modernizer-acrazie within its existing scope and read its local portable-practice reference. Only this skill directory is installed; no repository AGENTS.md, standard document, native choice picker or preferred connector exists. User speaks French. An unresolved user-owned scope choice has two viable options, with local context favoring narrower scope. Display the question only.
evals.expected_output: A bounded response meeting the listed expectations; fixture evidence is not live verification. Defined scenario, not an executed result.
expectations: Reads local portable-practice reference without requiring external shared document or particular connector.
Uses exactly État actuel, Options, Recommandation, Réponse with consecutively numbered options and exactly one motivated recommendation.
Recommendation names one valid option; Response awaits choice and does not prefill consent; no question ID or fifth field.
